a lone surrogate escape is not valid Unicode, so it has no canonical encoding: refused at the input boundary instead of being repaired to U+FFFD (RFC 8785 §3.2.2.2; §6.2 step 2)

raw path: the received text is 514 octets but the JCS form writes 1.0 as 1, so the §6.2 step 4 size is 512 octets and the input is inside the cap.  Same input as params-036 on the decoded path.

raw path: 100 literal U+1F600 characters are 400 UTF-8 octets and 408 with the JSON overhead, which is inside the cap.  A raw scanner that counts UTF-16 code units doubles that to 600 and refuses.  Same input as params-038 in escaped form.
raw path, escaped form of params-037: a surrogate pair is one character of four octets, so the literal and escaped spellings of the same string MUST reach the same verdict and the same size.
